what: Guidewire writes the core software property and casualty insurers run on: the systems that issue policies, handle claims and collect premiums.
customers: Property and casualty insurers worldwide, moving from decades-old systems onto its cloud platform.
money: the cloud platform, priced by premium volume
moat: Replacing a claims system is the largest IT project an insurer undertakes, takes years, and is done roughly once a generation. Once Guidewire is in, it stays.
risks: Implementations are long and expensive, which slows how fast customers can be converted
Services revenue carries low margins and dilutes the software economics
opportunities: $378M of free cash flow and $753M of cash against $757M of debt
Revenue grew from $813M to $1.5B in four years as the cloud transition progressed
Analysts see about 58% upside, with 15 covering the stock
watch: Annual recurring revenue growth and the number of cloud deals signed.
